testcase: MB-75122 part 1: predicate on LET variable with subquery is not used as index filter

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'IndexScan3' AND v.`index` = 'ifloix1' END AND NOT ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'IndexScan3' AND CONTAINS(IFMISSING(v.`filter`, ''), '`cv`') END

statements: SELECT d.c2, d.c6 FROM orders AS d USE INDEX (ifloix1) LET cv = (SELECT RAW o.c4 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.test_id = "idxfltr" AND o.c1 = 1 AND o.c2 = 311)[0] WHERE d.test_id = "idxfltr" AND d.c1 = 1 AND d.c4 < cv ORDER BY d.c2

testcase: MB-75122 part 2: OR predicate and chained LET variable referencing LET variable with subquery

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'IndexScan3' AND v.`index` = 'ifloix1' END AND NOT ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'IndexScan3' AND CONTAINS(IFMISSING(v.`filter`, ''), '`cv`') END

statements: SELECT d.c2, d.c6 FROM orders AS d USE INDEX (ifloix1) LET cv = (SELECT RAW o.c4 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.test_id = "idxfltr" AND o.c1 = 1 AND o.c2 = 311)[0], cv2 = cv + 100 WHERE d.test_id = "idxfltr" AND d.c1 = 1 AND cv IS NOT NULL AND (d.c4 < cv OR (d.c4 < cv2 AND d.c2 <= 311)) ORDER BY d.c2

testcase: MB-75122 part 3: UPDATE with predicate on LET variable with subquery

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'IndexScan3' AND v.`index` = 'ifloix1' END AND NOT ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'IndexScan3' AND CONTAINS(IFMISSING(v.`filter`, ''), '`cv`') END

statements: UPDATE orders AS d USE INDEX (ifloix1) LET cv = (SELECT RAW o.c4 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.test_id = "idxfltr" AND o.c1 = 1 AND o.c2 = 311)[0] SET d.c4 = d.c4 WHERE d.test_id = "idxfltr" AND d.c1 = 1 AND d.c4 < cv RETURNING d.c2
